name: R4-F5
description: R4-F5 was a blue-green and gray R4-P astromech droid that was permanently integrated into the Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor of Jedi Master Plo Koon. At the end of the Clone Wars, the droid was killed along with its master on the planet Cato Neimoidia when their ship was destroyed by Clone Captain Jag during the execution of Order 66.
